title: Ira
summary: Citizen; wakeful. (1.) A Tekoite, one of David's thirty warriors (2 Sam. 23:26).

inlines.v: Citizen; wakeful. (1.) A Tekoite, one of David's thirty warriors (2 Sam. 23:26).
(2.) An Ithrite, also one of David's heroes (2 Sam. 23:38).
(3.) A Jairite and priest, a royal chaplain (2 Sam. 20:26) or confidential adviser (comp. 2 Sam. 8:18; 1 Chr. 18:17).
